pyramiding_rule: No pyramiding into micro-pullbacks; only scale into positions after a confirmed 15-minute structural breakout with positive drift.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce ATR-based volatility buffer of at least 1.5x the 14-period average noise band before placing stop-loss limits.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate partial profit harvesting and move stop to break-even once open profit crosses +$5.00, allowing runners to stretch to +$15.00-$30.00.
